answer: Gate identity creation with an adaptive burn fee tied to intake volume: the first joiners in an epoch pay 10 tokens each, and the fee doubles with each doubling of intake, so a batch of 1,000 fakes faces a marginal price above 10,000 tokens apiece. Public prism counters make the current fee verifiable before anyone pays, and burned fees are never refunded when a batch is exposed. A whisper campaign of trial fakes still climbs the same curve, and a mass voyage of fake accounts must fund a total growing faster than its identity count, while a lone honest joiner pays only the base fee.
